name: text-random-order-fade
title: Random-Order Fade
description: Các ký tự sáng lên theo thứ tự ngẫu nhiên như sao nhấp nháy, mỗi ký tự kèm một tia lấp lánh nhỏ.

moworks.author: takayu

options.sparkle: a small four-point sparkle at each letter's top right

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-random-order-fade, written here): Split chars; seeded shuffled order (demo seed 11); the k-th char in that order starts at 0.3 s + k × 20–40 ms (whole build ≈1 s; demo up to 120 ms, capped 1.1 s total); opacity 0 → 1 over 0.3 s easeOutQuad. Demo adds a small 4-point accent sparkle at the char's top-right, growing and shrinking over 0.5 s (radius 5 px × sin). Loop exit: fade 2.65–2.95 s; loop 3 s. Params: duration (0.3 s) · total: cả đợt (1 s) · seed: thứ tự ngẫu nhiên · sparkle: tia lấp lánh (bật).
